record_title: Schatten-small radical shift with maximal power obstruction
provenance: An explicit unilateral weighted-shift construction uses one very small separator followed by a long constant plateau at each stage. The separator fixes the norm of a selected power, while the plateau forces exact multiplicativity at a prescribed higher power. The construction can be placed under any positive decreasing null envelope.
limitations: Originality is to the best of our knowledge. The qualitative existence of quasinilpotent weighted shifts whose generated radical algebras are not topologically nilpotent is prior art. Novelty is claimed only for the arbitrary-decay-envelope strengthening and its every-Schatten-class consequence with maximal finite-exponent power obstruction. Older radical-Banach-algebra and weighted-shift literature may contain an equivalent refinement under different terminology; Dixon (1991) and Shields (1974) were not exhaustively inspected in full.
